correction_register.decision: Distinguish developmental curriculum from recalled session order; neither alone establishes an RL algorithm.
Page 70 supports competitive pressure practice. External distraction conditioning and robotic perturbation robustness remain separate unverified mechanisms.

model_policy: Collection and ledger updates run every three hours; separate candidate evaluation may run when reviewed eligible data exist; no automatic active model replacement.

source_supported_findings.finding: Publisher jacket and contents support progression from putting toward the full swing after basic elements are mastered.
source_supported_findings.boundary: This supports instructional progression, not proof of an RL backward chaining implementation or improved sample efficiency.

source_supported_findings.finding: Tiger retrospectively describes learner initiative and supportive parental guidance.
source_supported_findings.boundary: Autobiographical testimony, not independent causal evidence.

source_supported_findings.finding: Tiger recalls sessions involving the pitching area followed by the putting green.
source_supported_findings.boundary: A practice session order need not equal a developmental curriculum; do not encode putting first as a rule for every session.

source_supported_findings.finding: Dedication and foreword connect education, care, support, integrity and the opportunity to express disagreement.
source_supported_findings.boundary: GRI institutional assurance mappings are analytical proposals, not mechanisms specified by the authors.

source_supported_findings.finding: Earl explicitly recommends beginning with putting, proceeding toward chipping, pitching and the full swing, using demonstration and familiar actions before advancing after proficiency.
source_supported_findings.boundary: Source supported pedagogical account; an RL curriculum and causal efficacy remain separate research propositions.

source_supported_findings.finding: The instruction links target visualization, short initial distance, later distance expansion and attention to ground conditions.
source_supported_findings.boundary: No claim that internal model representations are equivalent to human visualization.

source_supported_findings.finding: The account distinguishes practicing a repeatable stroke from practicing successful putts and emphasizes the first putt in longer distance play.
source_supported_findings.boundary: A basis for separately measuring action consistency, task success and residual error rather than a single reward.

source_supported_findings.finding: A competitive practice account describes pressure building with consecutive successful putts.
source_supported_findings.boundary: Supports practice under competitive pressure, not evidence of visual distraction, external force disturbances or zero shot robotic adaptation.

source_supported_findings.finding: Earl acknowledges limits to his instructional expertise and recommends objective assessment of when a teaching professional should take over.
source_supported_findings.boundary: Supports a proposed competence boundary and specialist escalation comparison; the continuation of the chapter is not supplied.

pending_source_requests: A passage explicitly describing external distraction conditioning, if this mechanism is to remain in the case; competitive pressure on page 70 is a distinct construct.

curriculum_experiment.primary_finding: No demonstrated nominal superiority of goal proximal curriculum
